emma (acct exec): FYI — HarborPay asking for a short POC to replace CompetitorX. They care about prompt parity, token billing differences, and enterprise security. Can we scope what we need for a 2-week eval?
omar (solutions): 👍 Need to confirm their core flows. Do they use streaming webhooks or synchronous responses?
emma (acct exec): They do streaming for user chat + webhook callbacks for events. Also want to validate chargeback cost model.
matt (engineer): Streaming is fine but note CompetitorX has a slightly different chunking behavior — might change client-side reconnection logic. We'll surface a mapping shim.
claire (security): On the security questionnaire: HarborPay requires KMS integration, SOC2 cert copy, and VPC peering for Private deployment. I'll need the customer’s compliance contact and the current CompetitorX answers.
omar (solutions): Can HarborPay share an example prompt set & sample API calls? If they can, we can run side-by-side diffs. Request: redacted PII only.
emma (acct exec): I'll ask for sanitized prompt examples and their webhook schema tonight.
matt (engineer): For prompt parity, two quick notes: 1) tokenization differences can change token counts — we should provide a token-estimate table. 2) default sampling params differ (temp/top_p). We'll include a recommended mapping: set temp to 0.0 for deterministic workflows.
omar (solutions): Can you paste the snippet we can run for side-by-side?
matt (engineer): Sure — minimal smoke command we use: 
```
# curl to our hosted endpoint
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-compat-1","prompt":"<<sanitized prompt>>","max_tokens":256,"stream":false}'
```
Use same prompt with CompetitorX call and diff outputs.
claire (security): Also: they flagged GDPR data residency. HarborPay wants EU-only processing. Confirm which regions our Private & Dedicated options support and lead time for EU Private.
emma (acct exec): Noted. I'll flag EU-only in the ask. Can we get a checklist of blockers and an ETA for a POC bundle (pricing + infra + security docs)?
omar (solutions): Blockers: sample prompts + webhook schema, KMS key exchange plan, VPC/IP allowlist, model parity doc (we'll map model family + quantization), estimate of token delta for their most common prompts. ETA: preliminary bundle in 3 business days if they share artifacts.
matt (engineer): On billing: We should show both token-based cost and per-request latency tier. Recommend offering a 30% introductory credit for the 2-week POC to offset re-instrumentation.
legal-bot: Draft NDAs and SOC2 attestation links can be shared. HarborPay legal contact? Once provided, I can push a one-way NDA in <24h.
claire (security): Quick security Qs to add to the form: do they require HSM-backed keys? Are there any banned IP ranges for egress? Also request their incident response lead.
emma (acct exec): I'll gather contacts and sanitized data by EOD.
omar (solutions): Once we have prompts, I'll run a 1-hour side-by-side and post a short diff summary (token delta, major response differences, any hallucination gaps).
matt (engineer): If we see consistent output deltas tied to sampling, we can provide a small compatibility shim — configuration only, no code change for HarborPay. If it's prompt-engine behavior, we'll recommend prompt transforms.
emma (acct exec): Perfect. I'll update HarborPay tonight: 1) we can do the POC, 2) need artifacts, 3) expect bundle in 3 business days after artifacts, 4) recommend 30% credit.
omar (solutions): 👍 lgtm. I'll standby for the prompt set.
claire (security): Add me to HarborPay's security thread once NDA is signed.
emma (acct exec): Will do. Thanks team :rocket:
